_comment: Spacing-identity drill: Infantry (pyknosis 0.9 m) beside Cavalry (2 x 6 m Normal). Select foot, T to Tight 0.45 m locked, T to Loose 1.8 m. Select horse (2 x 6 m), T to Tight 1 x 3 m locked, T to Loose 4 x 12 m. ~2.5 s holds after each T so bodies ease onto the new pitch. Fresh scenario; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

path_crossing.reason: The Tight->Loose (1x->4x) expansion re-slots the 36 men across a quadrupling pitch, so half the routes measured from the t170 Tight hold cross while the block spreads (routes measured across the whole cycle, Normal->Loose net, do not cross). The clip's claim is the interval labels and the pitch identity through the cycle, and it deliberately films this expansion.

overlap.reason: At the t510 Tight sample one horse pair is still resolving the 2x->1x pack (min neighbour 4.25 wu) while the block's 25th-percentile and median neighbour distances already sit on the 20 wu knee-to-knee file pitch. A transient straggler pair during the sampled pack, not standing interpenetration.

shape_residual.reason: The t680 sample catches the horses mid-walk from Tight (1 x 3 m) onto the 4x Loose grid (4 x 12 m, ~44 m wide for 24 horses) -- RMS slot error reads distance-to-destination while in transit. The clip ends before open order finishes forming; the label change and pitch identity, not settled geometry, are what it demonstrates.
